mechanism: Torsemide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may impair renal function and affect lamivudine clearance, which is renally eliminated; both agents require adequate renal function for safety.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes regularly; ensure adequate hydration; adjust lamivudine dosing if renal function declines below GFR 50 mL/min.
